_what: gate2/freq -- independent wire measurement of the two claimed objects. All numbers from the cached rlogs; no model, no fork constant used to FIND a frequency. Scripts s1..s13 in this folder.
mask: engaged = carControl.latActive AND 0xE4 STEER_REQUEST; hands-off = NOT carState.steeringPressed

r71_object.method: cycle-by-cycle zero crossings (2.357 [2.322,2.401], n=22 cycles) + amplitude-weighted spectral mean (2.300 [2.284,2.313]) over the two big hands-off episodes t=660.6-666.3 and 670.2-675.0 s

r73_object_handsoff.method: amplitude^2-weighted census of 4 s engaged-hands-off v>=15 windows, whitened peak, weighted bootstrap; amp-wt median 4.93, IQR [4.50,5.25]; weighted mean 5.22 [4.97,5.60]

r73_object_driver_contact.note: excluded by the gate's own engaged-hands-off >=15 m/s convention; it is r73's LARGEST oscillation

r73_at_2p0_2p6Hz.verdict: r73 has NO 2.3 Hz object. Gate #1's report CONFIRMED. The 2.0-2.6 envelope excursions on r73 are filter skirt from the 2.775 Hz driver-contact object (same timestamps).

v282_clean.verdict: CLEAN is well supported -- no object anywhere in 2-6.5 Hz. The five clean routes are NOT homogeneous: V282 << r72 < r75.

r75_warning.consequence: any AMPLITUDE-scoring statistic ranks r75 (CLEAN, rev 6.4 as flown) above r73 (POSITIVE) and fails clause (b) and clause (c). Only FREQUENCY PLACEMENT separates them.

r74_unscoreable.consequence: the 'T64 / rev 6.4 (2 routes)' row is effectively ONE scoreable route (r75)

relay_signature_from_the_wire.statistic: median over engaged-hands-off v>=15 8s windows of band power of controlsState output in 3-9 Hz / 0.2-1.0 Hz
relay_signature_from_the_wire.verdict: matches the anchor set's relay column EXACTLY, 23-50x separation. r75's SteerFriction 0.2120 is confirmed GUARDED OFF; r73's 0.2120 is confirmed LIVE; the three V282 routes are confirmed relay-live.
relay_signature_from_the_wire.warning: the relay's OUTPUT-side signature is LARGER on the three CLEAN V282 routes (0.0465-0.0508) than on POSITIVE r71 (0.0277). Relay presence cannot carry the statistic.

same_or_different.verdict: SAME FAMILY, NOT THE SAME OBJECT
for: both frequencies scale with the fork's own sqrt(k(v)/J)/2pi law at a CONSTANT multiple over 10-28 m/s: r71 x1.33, r73 x2.39-2.70, r75 x1.6-2.0
both near-sinusoidal at the wheel (2f/f <= 0.08), both near-neutral in damping, both only while LKAS engaged and requesting
both positives are wire-confirmed relay-live; r72 and r75 are wire-confirmed relay-dead
against: r73 has a HOLE where r71's object is (0.54x its own matched control; whitened <= 1.29) -- it is not r71's object plus an extra one
regimes differ: r71 hard curve / hands-off / 4.8-5.7 s / 85-93 deg/s / in-band 0.93-0.96; r73 near-straight / 0.6-1.1 s / 27-48 deg/s / in-band 0.18-0.24
same_or_different.consequence_for_clause_a: WELL-POSED in principle -- one loop model CAN place both, because both are closed-loop crossings on a common speed-scheduled plant. But the model must move the crossing from 1.33x to 2.08x (4.93/2.37) the plant mode from the x19.3 relay change plus the AccordRateLoopGain 0.0006 and the Q=1.0 notch that r71 did not fly.
